autoCompleteNotReady: Available once a foundation builds past its ace

tutorial.foundation: Four foundations sit beside the reserve, pre-seeded with the four Aces. Build each pile by suit from Ace to King.
tutorial.reserve: The reserve (Lawrence) holds seven single face-up cards. They can leave for the tableau or a foundation, but nothing ever moves back into the reserve.
tutorial.tableau: Nine open columns are dealt face-up. Only the rightmost card of each column is playable.
tutorial.moves: Pack the tableau in alternating colors, one rank lower (red on black, black on red). Empty columns accept any card.
tutorial.controls: Use hint, undo, and auto-complete buttons.

hintReason.toFoundation: Send this card to the foundation to free up the column.
hintReason.toTableau: Apply the suggested tableau move to unlock buried cards.
